Newsletter

A news app I developed to help readers explore reporting from different perspectives.

Visit Newsletter

Meerkat

The backend pipeline for Newsletter. It collects, translates and analyses articles, then prepares them for publication in the app.

Scheduled AWS Fargate tasks process the articles. PostgreSQL stores the results, and a Flask API serves the published material.
